full_judgment: 1. This rule has been obtained by the defendant against the order dated 30.7.69 passed in Misc. Case No. 9 of 1960 under Order 9 Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure by the learned Munsif, 2nd Court Sirajgonj and has arisen in the following circumstances Opposite parties Nos. 1 and 2 as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 2 of 1966 for declaration of title and khas possession of the suit land on partition against the defendant petitioner and on 17.2.69 the suit was decreed exparte in preliminary form. This exparte decree was, however set aside on an application of the defendant petitioner on 11.7.69 under Order 9 Rule 13 which was registered as Misc Case No. 9 of 1969 and the Court recorded the following order:
